language.name: Kestrel Kickoff
language.rationale: This design language embodies Kestrel Athletic's kinetic, matchday energy through sharp angles, bold typography, and a vivid accent, ensuring a dynamic and highly readable on-air presence for live football coverage.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (compact density - 18/25px padding, 8px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a bar fused to the panel's leading edge, outside its padding
motion: snap at fast pace → preset slide-up
